name: MENA-Water
capability_summary:
Key Results
MBR & SBR Package Plants, Pretreatment (screens, grit, grease removal), Secondary Treatment (diffusers, mixers, scrapers, scum removal, sludge thickeners), Advanced Treatment (DAF, cloth screw filter, UF/NF/RO), Sludge Treatment (thickening, dewatering, drying), Odor Control (activated carbon, biofilters, chemical scrubbers), Renewable Energy for water (biogas/digesters, solar/wind pumps), Instrumentation & Control including online water quality, flow meters, gas detection, dosing systems and SCADA, Wide geographic delivery footprint (UAE, Germany, MENA region and claims of worldwide service), Limited publicly‑documented named software/hardware or detailed SCADA/OT cybersecurity products, No publicly listed formal partner/vendor agreements or detailed utility case studies found on primary corporate pages
data_caveat: Clay-reported size bands; some employee counts conflict. No willingness/eligibility inferred.
